value.rationale: The terminal-site probability distribution alone hides a large temporal selection effect: for rare last positions proportional to x on a biased cycle, the conditional expected cover time has a sharp factor 2-x relative to typical first-order behavior. The finite exact formula, uniform exponential remainder and rare-event exponent quantify how geometry couples time and the final site, a natural joint stopping-time observable for cover times. The statement is not a simple relabeling or an unmotivated numerical slice; it describes the entire bulk of atypical locations for all fixed p>1/2. No extension to drift tending to zero, or full conditional limit law, is claimed.
